paragraphs.text: At a repair café, volunteers help visitors mend broken things instead of doing the work for them. Most cafés meet once a month in a hall or a library, and there is no charge, though visitors may leave a donation.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: Kettles, lamps and clothes are the commonest items. Around six repairs in ten succeed; the rest fail for lack of spare parts. Several cafés keep a list of items they will not touch, such as microwave ovens.
paragraphs.label: B

items.prompt: Volunteers repair the items while visitors wait.
Visitors have to pay a fixed price.
Microwave ovens are the item brought most often.
